items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: first band we organized was Lawrence on banjo, Adam Morrell on the bass

ctx.x: Did you...when you took up drums, did you have any lessons? Did your father help you or any...

No, no, no one learned how to play the drums. And in later years, in later years when I was...first band we organized was Lawrence on banjo, Adam Morrell on the bass, which is Lawrence's brother, cousin of mine. He's still living.
You see the one that's still living?
